en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

We've come all this way to the gym, so
of course, we have to move our bodies!

But I guess degenerate males don't
even know something obvious like that...

Then I guess you're better than the other
degenerates, Shuichi.

Oh! I'm surprised to hear that from
a degenerate!

I thought males were totally fine with how
disgusting their rooms were...

Can it be!? Have you realized your own
filthiness!?

That's a huge step forward! You should try
even harder and get rid of all your filth!

Fine, go ahead.
You're free to pass out right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
